fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious usage of the ShellExec_RunDLL function to launch other commands as seen in the the raspberry-robin attack
fields.name: Suspicious Usage Of ShellExec_RunDLL
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "ShellExec_RunDLL" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Desktop\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Temp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Users\\Public\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "comspec" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "iex" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Invoke-" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "msiexec" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "odbcconf" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "regsvr32")))
